translations.web: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
translations.bsb: Listen! My beloved approaches. Look! Here he comes, leaping across the mountains, bounding over the hills.
translations.kjv: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
translations.asv: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh, Leaping upon the mountains, Skipping upon the hills.
